item.title: REF 0.6.0
item.description:
• Bands now fit EDM by default. Sub runs up to 90 Hz (the sub layer and the kick's fundamental), and Bass is 90–180 Hz on its own, so a heavy or thin kick body around 100–150 Hz shows up instead of being averaged away. The old split (sub to 60 Hz) is still in Settings.
  • Waveforms have a new look, Layers, closer to Traktor's: lows pink, mids violet, highs blue, each drawn as its own see-through layer. Kicks stand out as thin pink lines, even in a loud, limited master.
  • The REF plug-in is now a meter until you drop in a reference: loudness, peaks, spectrum and stereo fill its window. Drop a song anywhere on the meters to compare, and Remove takes the reference out again. Its Your mix row is gone: it measures the master as your DAW plays.
  • The REF plug-in gets the new bands and waveforms too: restart your DAW after installing.
